title: wg: protocol-07 §5.7 consent response paragraphs are spliced (201 and 202 both present)
description: draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-07 §5.7 (txt L2355-2370 requestConsent, L2439-2449 updateConsent): the -06 paragraph's opening ("usually a 201 Accepted ... Likewise in response to a cancel which has no request matching the") runs straight into the #173 replacement ("The response to a requestConsent request is usually a 202 Accepted ... gets a 422 Unprocessable Content response"); same for updateConsent ("A provider that does not The response to an updateConsent ..."). Looks like a bad merge of mimi-protocol#173 into the -07 source. Fix in the editor's copy: delete the stale 201 fragment in both places. mimid implements the complete 202/422 text (decision on mimid-1wgh.7.42). Posting upstream needs Mark's OK.
